notes.18r.5: kingur: a kinga is properly a round ornament or disc; here it stands for the lost coins of the parable (Luke 15). ǽrir and hǫfuðǽrir, 'messengers' and 'chief messengers', are the angels and archangels; kraftar, veldisenglar, hǫfðingjar, dróttnar and stólar (literally 'strengths, power-angels, chieftains, lords, seats') are given their usual English names.
notes.18r.23: 18r.24: 'n nǫfn' is read as án nafna, 'without names'. Himnasjón Johannis, 'John's Vision of Heaven', is the Book of Revelation. kraftar is 'powers' in 'the Lord of powers' and 'Virtues' as the name of an angelic order; veldisenglar ('power-angels') are the Powers, hǫfðingjar ('chieftains') the Principalities.

nodes.text: of his own, for eternal glory, angels and men. This woman had ten coins because there are nine orders of angels, and
man was created as the tenth, to complete the full number. And when he did wrong, he was visited by
heavenly wisdom, which appeared in a body and restored him by a kindled light, that is, by signs of godhead shown
through a human body. There are nine orders of angels, which the holy scriptures name.
They are messengers and chief messengers, Virtues and Powers, Principalities, Dominions and Thrones, cherubim,
that is, the fullness of wisdom, and seraphim, that is, the burning or blazing ones. All books'
names for this reason, that they signify in their names what they can do in deeds. Angels do not have
proper names for this reason, that each of them could not know another's will without names. But when they come
to us, they take names here from their ministry. Michael is interpreted thus: Who is like God.
Gabriel is called the strength of God, and Raphael the healing of God. Michael is sent for this,
to do glorious mighty works, so that it may be shown in his name and in deed that God alone can
do what no other can. Therefore it is said in John's Vision of Heaven that the ancient fiend would
be slain at the end of the world by Michael the archangel. Since this fiend in his pride wished
to make himself like God and set his seat above the clouds of heaven and set his throne against God, it is
fitting that that angel should break his might who shows in his name that none is such
as God. For no one can make himself like God through pride. And Gabriel was sent
to Mary, he who is called the strength of God, because he came to announce him who fought mightily
against the fiend and overcame him in humility, as the psalmist says: The Lord is strong and
mighty in battle, the Lord of powers himself. He is the Lord of powers and strong to fight
against spiritual wickedness. Raphael is interpreted the healing of God, because he took the darkness of blindness
from the eyes of Tobias by his office of healing. It was fitting that he should be called God's healing
who was sent to heal the sick. And now we have interpreted the names of the angels. Therefore we shall
also say something about their ministries. Those spirits are called Virtues who most often show
miracles here. Those are called Powers who have it in their might to restrain devils,
so that they cannot tempt men as they wish. Those are called Principalities who [send] other good
they [found] there an idol made of bronze, and threw it into the kitchen in the evening. And that night fire seemed to the monks
to burn from the idol. And it seemed to all of them as if the whole kitchen were ablaze. And when they carried water to
